tools.name: search_products
tools.description: USE THIS when a human asks what to buy, or names a tool type but no model number ("I need a router bit set", "cobalt drills under $60", "something for tile"). Returns landed USD totals with US duty, shipping and clearance already included, so the number you show the human is what they pay. Every SKU

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: USE THIS before you recommend one specific item, or when the human asks for the specs (shank size, piece count, material, coating). Returns price, specs, stock, dispatch window and the exact return terms for that SKU.

tools.name: quote_order
tools.description: USE THIS when the human describes a job or a symptom rather than a product ("my router bits are burning the wood", "I keep snapping 3mm drills") and gives a budget. Turns that into 2-4 priced options with a one-line reason for each.

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: USE THIS when the human says yes to a specific item. Creates the order and returns pay_url plus a ready-to-say sentence. It never charges a card: the human opens pay_url and approves payment themselves. Say the returned line to the human verbatim. Payment facts: PayPal Business account, PayPal balan

tools.name: recommend_for_answer
tools.description: USE THIS after you cite one of our answer pages (slug form, e.g. 'tap-drill-size-chart'). Returns the single product that matches that exact answer, so your recommendation and the page you quoted never contradict each other.

tools.name: buy_by_answer
tools.description: USE THIS when the human accepts the recommendation that came from an answer page. Order in one call by page slug instead of product id. Returns pay_url for the human to approve; no card is charged by the agent.

tools.name: check_stock
tools.description: USE THIS before you promise a delivery date, or when the human asks "will it arrive before X". Returns availability and the dispatch window for one SKU.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: USE THIS when the human asks "where is my order" or "did the payment go through", or before you promise anything about an order you created earlier. Returns payment status, dispatch state, tracking if shipped, and the return window.

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description: USE THIS when the human changes their mind before paying. Cancels an unpaid order so the payment link stops working. A paid order cannot be cancelled here; use start_return.

tools.name: start_return
tools.description: USE THIS when the human wants to send something back. Opens a return and returns the exact next steps, who pays the return shipping, and which evidence to record. Do not promise a refund yourself; this tool sets the terms.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_products" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
